newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-PEREZ HAT-TRICK KEEPS BETIS IN CHASE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PEREZ HAT-TRICK KEEPS BETIS IN CHASE.

text.p: Alfonso Perez completed a brilliant hat-trick in injury time as Real Betis staged a dramatic 3-2 win over Spanish champions Atletico Madrid on Sunday.
The winner came just as Barcelona, 3-0 winners over Compostela, looked set to put two points between them and the Seville side in the fight for Spain's second place in the European Cup.
Barcelona remained ahead on goal difference but both clubs trail Real Madrid by six ahead of the leaders' home clash with Racing Santander on Monday.
Alfonso's late goal came after Atletico had taken the lead midway through the first half through Juan Eduardo Esnaider, who was sent off moments later.
Alfonso responded with strikes either side of halftime, before an own goal during a defensive mix-up had seemed to cost the home side two points.
